name.description: The logical name of this Heat API service instance.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of log output. Choose from DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, or TRACE.

log_dir.description: Directory where heat-api log files are written (used only if use_syslog is false).

log_file.description: Filename for the primary heat-api log file (if use_syslog is false).

use_syslog.description: Enable logging to syslog instead of local files.

syslog_log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog.

bind_host.description: The IP address the Heat API server will bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces or a specific IP for security.

bind_port.description: The TCP port on which the Heat API server listens for requests.

paste_config.description: Path to the PasteDeploy configuration file for the WSGI pipeline.

auth_protocol.description: Protocol (http or https) to use when connecting to Keystone for authentication.

auth_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Keystone admin service.

auth_port.description: Port of the Keystone admin service (used for token validation, policy enforcement).

auth_uri.description: Public Keystone endpoint for user authentication (v3 endpoint recommended).

project_domain_name.description: Domain name containing the service project.

user_domain_name.description: Domain name containing the Heat service user.

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name where the Heat service account resides.

username.description: Username of the service account Heat uses to authenticate with Keystone.

password.description: Password for the Heat service user in Keystone.

interface.description: Keystone endpoint interface type: internal (recommended), public, or admin.

cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for SSL/TLS verification of Keystone (leave empty to skip verification — insecure).

insecure.description: Disable SSL/TLS certificate verification (only for dev/testing — never in production).

auth_type.description: Authentication type used for trustee operations (e.g., password).

endpoint_type.description: Endpoint type for internal client calls to Keystone (internal, public, or admin).

auth_uri_ec2.description: EC2-compatible auth endpoint for legacy EC2-style requests (optional).

rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP of the RabbitMQ server used for message transport.

rabbit_port.description: Port of the RabbitMQ server (standard AMQP port).

rabbit_virtual_host.description: RabbitMQ virtual host to use for Heat messages.

rabbit_use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for RabbitMQ connections (recommended for production).

heartbeat_timeout_threshold.description: Seconds of heartbeat silence before RabbitMQ connection is considered dead.

heartbeat_rate.description: Rate (in seconds) at which heat-api sends heartbeats to RabbitMQ.

policy_file.description: Path to the JSON policy rules file for RBAC enforcement.

policy_default_rule.description: Fallback rule name used when a rule is not found.

lock_path.description: Directory for file-based locking to ensure thread/process safety.

url.description: Cache backend URL — required for non-memory backends (e.g., Redis URL).

expiration_time.description: Default TTL (in seconds) for cache entries.

enabled.description: Enable response caching (e.g., for API metadata).
